title: "Salt is the Soul of Hakka Baked Chicken": Reimagining Traditional Chinese Culinary ICH for Modern Contexts Without Losing Tradition

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through participatory workshops and interviews where experienced practitioners of traditional Chinese cuisine interacted with Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Doubao, Zhipu) to co-create recipes and generate food images, assessing the outputs for Western-centric culinary influences, culturally inconsistent ingredients, and non-traditional visual styles.
